segments.name: Malls
segments.description: Owns and operates enclosed large regional shopping centers for retail, restaurant and non-retail tenants seeking space in anchored malls.
segments.evidence: The malls reporting segment consists of enclosed large regional shopping centers, generally anchored by two or more anchors or junior anchors

segments.name: Lifestyle centers
segments.description: Owns and operates large open-air lifestyle centers anchored by department stores, grocers or other anchors, leased to retail and other tenants.
segments.evidence: The lifestyle center reporting segment consists of large open-air centers, generally anchored by one or more anchors

segments.name: Outlet centers
products: brand name off-price or discount in-line stores
segments.description: Owns and operates open-air outlet centers anchored by discount or off-price junior anchors and leased to brand name off-price stores.
segments.evidence: The outlet center reporting segment consists of open-air centers, generally anchored by one or more discount or off-price junior anchors

segments.name: Open-air centers
segments.description: Owns and operates open-air shopping centers anchored by supermarkets, value-priced stores, big-box retailers or traditional department stores, often near its malls.
segments.evidence: The open-air centers reporting segment is typically anchored by a combination of supermarkets, value-priced stores, big-box retailers or traditional department stores

segments.name: All Other
segments.description: Holds outparcels, office buildings, hotels, corporate-level debt and the Management Company, which fees for management, development and leasing services.
segments.evidence: The All Other category includes outparcels, office buildings, hotels, corporate-level debt and the Management Company.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay rent and reimburse property operating costs under leases at the company's shopping centers and other properties.
revenueModel.evidence: Rental income and tenant reimbursements from tenant leases provide the majority of revenues from all segments.
